source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

method: Every pinned Greek verse read before authoring. All verses drafted before reading prior Fluent. TSW is a post-authoring comparator, not a wording template. Each authored verse has its own rationale. F0–F3 choices are provisional; no independent review or change quota.

verses.rationale: Keeps all three senders, the community's twofold location and the concise blessing.
verses.before: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace.
verses.after: Paul, Silvanus and Timothy, to the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace and peace to you.
verses.tsw_comparator: Paul and Silvanus and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace.

verses.rationale: Preserves always/all emphasis and prayerful remembrance.
verses.before: We always thank God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,
verses.after: We always thank God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers.
verses.tsw_comparator: We give thanks to God always for all of you, constantly mentioning you in our prayers,

verses.rationale: Keeps the three genitive pairs and their Christ-centered horizon.
verses.before: remembering before our God and Father your work produced by trust, your labor from love, and your endurance from hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.after: Before our God and Father, we continually remember your work produced by faith, your labor prompted by love and your endurance inspired by hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.tsw_comparator: remembering before our God and Father your work of faith and labor of love and steadfastness of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.rationale: Retains family address, divine love and election.
verses.before: Brothers and sisters loved by God, we know that he has chosen you,
verses.after: Brothers and sisters loved by God, we know that he has chosen you,
verses.tsw_comparator: For we know, brothers and sisters beloved by God, your election,

verses.rationale: Preserves the threefold manner and points to embodied conduct.
verses.before: because our good news came to you not in word only but also in power, in the Holy Spirit, and with full conviction. You know what kind of people we were among you for your sake.
verses.after: because our good news came to you not in word alone, but also in power, in the Holy Spirit and with deep conviction. You know what kind of people we became among you for your sake.
verses.tsw_comparator: because our good news came to you not only in word but also in power and in the Holy Spirit and with full conviction; just as you know what kind of people we proved to be among you for your sake.

verses.rationale: Keeps imitation, suffering and Spirit-given joy together.
verses.before: You became imitators of us and of the Lord, receiving the word in much affliction with the joy of the Holy Spirit,
verses.after: You became imitators of us and of the Lord, receiving the word in severe affliction with joy from the Holy Spirit.
verses.tsw_comparator: And you became imitators of us and of the Lord, receiving the word in much affliction, with joy from the Holy Spirit,

verses.rationale: Retains both regions and the community's representative role.
verses.before: so that you became an example to all the believers in Macedonia and Achaia.
verses.after: As a result, you became an example to all the believers in Macedonia and Achaia.
verses.tsw_comparator: so that you became an example to all the believers in Macedonia and in Achaia.

verses.rationale: Keeps the sounding image, geographic expansion and rhetorical result.
verses.before: For from you the Lord’s word has sounded out not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but your trust toward God has gone out everywhere, so that we have no need to say anything.
verses.after: For the Lord's word rang out from you not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but your faith toward God has gone out everywhere, so that we need not say anything.
verses.tsw_comparator: For from you the word of the Lord has sounded forth, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but in every place your faith toward God has gone out, so that we have no need to say anything.

verses.rationale: Preserves outsiders' report, conversion movement and slave-service verb.
verses.before: They themselves report what kind of welcome we had among you, and how you turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God,
verses.after: They themselves report what kind of reception we had among you and how you turned to God from idols, to serve the living and true God
verses.tsw_comparator: For they themselves report about us what kind of reception we had among you, and how you turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God,

verses.rationale: Keeps waiting, resurrection, the personal name and future deliverance.
verses.before: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead—Jesus, who rescues us from the coming wrath.
verses.after: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead—Jesus, who rescues us from the coming wrath.
verses.tsw_comparator: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead—Jesus, who rescues us from the coming wrath.

verses.rationale: Retains the appeal to shared knowledge and fruitlessness image.
verses.before: You yourselves know, brothers and sisters, that our coming to you was not empty.
verses.after: You yourselves know, brothers and sisters, that our coming to you was not empty.
verses.tsw_comparator: For you yourselves know, brothers and sisters, that our coming to you was not in vain,

verses.rationale: Keeps the named place, abuse, boldness and conflict.
verses.before: Although we had already suffered and been mistreated in Philippi, as you know, we had boldness in our God to speak God’s good news to you in the face of much opposition.
verses.after: Although we had already suffered and been mistreated in Philippi, as you know, our God gave us courage to speak his good news to you amid great struggle.
verses.tsw_comparator: but though we had already suffered and been shamefully treated in Philippi, as you know, we had boldness in our God to speak to you the good news of God amid much conflict.

verses.rationale: Preserves the three denied sources.
verses.before: For our appeal does not come from error, impurity, or deception.
verses.after: For our appeal does not spring from error, impurity or deceit.
verses.tsw_comparator: For our appeal does not come from error or impurity or deceit,

verses.rationale: Keeps divine testing before and during the entrusted speech.
verses.before: Instead, just as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the good news, so we speak—not to please people but God, who examines our hearts.
verses.after: Instead, just as God approved us to be entrusted with the good news, so we speak—not to please people, but God, who tests our hearts.
verses.tsw_comparator: but just as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the good news, so we speak—not to please human beings, but God, who tests our hearts.

verses.rationale: Retains human knowledge, divine witness and both denied manipulations.
verses.before: For we never came with flattering speech, as you know, or with a pretext for greed—God is our witness—
verses.after: For we never came with flattering speech, as you know, or with a pretext for greed—God is our witness.
verses.tsw_comparator: For we never came with words of flattery, as you know, nor with a pretext for greed—God is witness—

verses.rationale: Keeps the comprehensive denial and named audiences.
verses.before: nor did we seek glory from people, either from you or from others,
verses.after: Nor did we seek glory from people, whether from you or from others.
verses.tsw_comparator: nor seeking glory from people, whether from you or from others, though we could have made demands as apostles of Christ.

verses.rationale: Preserves apostolic claim and the explicitly maternal caregiving image.
verses.before: though as Christ’s apostles we could have made demands. Instead, we became gentle among you, like a nursing mother caring tenderly for her own children.
verses.after: Though we could have asserted our weight as Christ's apostles, we became gentle among you, like a nursing mother tenderly caring for her own children.
verses.tsw_comparator: But we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother caring for her own children.

verses.rationale: Keeps intense affection and self-sharing beyond speech.
verses.before: Having such deep affection for you, we were pleased to share with you not only God’s good news but also our own lives, because you had become beloved to us.
verses.after: Because we yearned for you, we were pleased to share with you not only God's good news but our own lives as well, since you had become dear to us.
verses.tsw_comparator: So, having deep affection for you, we were pleased to share with you not only the good news of God but also our own lives, because you had become dear to us.

verses.rationale: Retains bodily work, time span and financial purpose.
verses.before: You remember, brothers and sisters, our labor and hardship. We worked night and day so that we would not burden any of you while we announced God’s good news to you.
verses.after: You remember our labor and hardship, brothers and sisters. Working night and day so as not to burden any of you, we proclaimed God's good news to you.
verses.tsw_comparator: For you remember, brothers and sisters, our labor and toil: working night and day so that we might not burden any of you, we proclaimed to you the good news of God.

verses.rationale: Keeps dual witness and all three ethical claims.
verses.before: You are witnesses, and so is God, of how holy, righteous, and blameless we were toward you who trust.
verses.after: You are witnesses, and so is God, of how holy, just and blameless our conduct was toward you who believe.
verses.tsw_comparator: You are witnesses, and God also, how holy and righteous and blameless our conduct was toward you who believe;

verses.rationale: Preserves individual attention and the paternal family image.
verses.before: You know how, like a father with his own children, we encouraged, comforted, and urged each one of you
verses.after: You know that we treated each one of you as a father treats his own children:
verses.tsw_comparator: just as you know how we exhorted each one of you, as a father with his own children,

verses.rationale: Keeps three pastoral actions, walk image and divine calling.
verses.before: to walk worthy of God, who calls you into his own kingdom and glory.
verses.after: encouraging, comforting and urging you to walk worthy of God, who calls you into his own kingdom and glory.
verses.tsw_comparator: encouraging and urging you to walk worthy of God, who calls you into his own kingdom and glory.

verses.rationale: Preserves reception/acceptance distinction and the word's continuing efficacy.
verses.before: We also thank God continually because when you received God’s word that you heard from us, you accepted it not as a human word but, as it truly is, God’s word, which is also at work in you who trust.
verses.after: We also thank God without ceasing because, when you received God's word that you heard from us, you accepted it not as a human word but as what it truly is, God's word, which is also at work in you who believe.
verses.tsw_comparator: And we also give thanks to God continually for this, that when you received the word of God that you heard from us, you accepted it not as a human word but as what it truly is, the word of God, which is at work in you who believe.

verses.rationale: Keeps local perpetrators distinct and does not generalize the polemic beyond the comparison.
verses.before: For you, brothers and sisters, became imitators of God’s churches in Christ Jesus that are in Judea, because you suffered the same things from your own people as they did from some of their Judean opponents,
verses.after: For you, brothers and sisters, became imitators of God's churches in Judea that are in Christ Jesus: you suffered the same things from your own compatriots as they did from the Judeans
verses.tsw_comparator: For you became imitators, brothers and sisters, of the churches of God that are in Judea in Christ Jesus, because you suffered the same things from your own people as they did from the Jews,

verses.rationale: Retains the source's severe accusations as the letter's rhetoric without softening them.
verses.before: who killed both the Lord Jesus and the prophets and drove us out. They displease God and oppose all people
verses.after: who killed both the Lord Jesus and the prophets and drove us out. They displease God and oppose everyone,
verses.tsw_comparator: who killed both the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and drove us out, and do not please God and are hostile to all people,

verses.rationale: Keeps the prohibited mission, accumulated sins and judgment claim.
verses.before: by hindering us from speaking to the Gentiles so they may be saved. In this way they keep filling up their sins. But wrath has come upon them to the end.
verses.after: hindering us from speaking to the nations so that they may be saved. In this way they always fill up their sins. But wrath has overtaken them at last.
verses.tsw_comparator: hindering us from speaking to the Gentiles so that they may be saved—so as always to fill up their sins. But wrath has come upon them at last.

verses.rationale: Retains the unusual orphan image and face/heart contrast.
verses.before: But we, brothers and sisters, after being separated from you for a short time—in person, not in heart—made every effort, with great desire, to see you face to face.
verses.after: But when we were orphaned from you, brothers and sisters, for a short time—in person, not in heart—we made every effort, with great longing, to see you face to face.
verses.tsw_comparator: But we, brothers and sisters, having been torn away from you for a short time—in person, not in heart—endeavored all the more eagerly with great desire to see your face,

verses.rationale: Keeps Paul's personal clarification, repetition and named opponent.
verses.before: We wanted to come to you—I, Paul, again and again—but Satan blocked our way.
verses.after: We wanted to come to you—I, Paul, tried again and again—but Satan blocked us.
verses.tsw_comparator: because we wanted to come to you—I, Paul, again and again—but Satan hindered us.

verses.rationale: Preserves the rhetorical question, crown image and future presence.
verses.before: For what is our hope, joy, or crown of boasting before our Lord Jesus at his coming? Is it not you?
verses.after: For who is our hope, joy or crown of boasting before our Lord Jesus at his coming? Is it not you?
verses.tsw_comparator: For what is our hope or joy or crown of boasting before our Lord Jesus at his coming? Is it not you?

verses.rationale: Retains the emphatic identification.
verses.before: Yes, you are our glory and joy.
verses.after: Indeed, you are our glory and joy.
verses.tsw_comparator: For you are our glory and joy.

verses.rationale: Keeps emotional pressure, decision and named city.
verses.before: Therefore, when we could no longer bear it, we thought it best to be left alone in Athens,
verses.after: So when we could bear it no longer, we decided to be left alone in Athens,
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore, when we could bear it no longer, we were willing to be left behind in Athens alone,

verses.rationale: Preserves Timothy's two relationships and two purposes.
verses.before: and we sent Timothy, our brother and God’s coworker in the good news of Christ, to strengthen and encourage you concerning your trust,
verses.after: and we sent Timothy, our brother and God's coworker in Christ's good news, to strengthen and encourage you in your faith,
verses.tsw_comparator: and we sent Timothy, our brother and God’s coworker in the good news of Christ, to strengthen and encourage you concerning your faith,

verses.rationale: Keeps the suffering real and the difficult appointment language.
verses.before: so that no one would be shaken by these afflictions. For you yourselves know that we are destined for this.
verses.after: so that no one would be shaken by these afflictions. You yourselves know that we are destined for them.
verses.tsw_comparator: so that no one might be shaken by these afflictions. For you yourselves know that we are appointed for this.

verses.rationale: Preserves prior prediction, actual suffering and their knowledge.
verses.before: Indeed, when we were with you, we kept telling you beforehand that we were going to suffer affliction, and it happened just as you know.
verses.after: Even when we were with you, we kept warning you that we were going to suffer affliction, and it happened just as you know.
verses.tsw_comparator: For even when we were with you, we kept telling you beforehand that we were to suffer affliction, just as it has come to pass, and you know.

verses.rationale: Keeps Paul's fear, named tempter and potential wasted work.
verses.before: For this reason, when I could no longer bear it, I sent to learn about your trust, fearing that somehow the tempter had tested you and our labor might have been in vain.
verses.after: For this reason, when I could bear it no longer, I sent to learn about your faith, fearing that somehow the tempter had tempted you and our labor had become empty.
verses.tsw_comparator: For this reason, when I could bear it no longer, I sent to learn about your faith, lest somehow the tempter had tempted you and our labor would be in vain.

verses.rationale: Retains the report's timing, contents and reciprocal longing.
verses.before: But Timothy has just now come to us from you and brought us good news about your trust and love. He told us that you always remember us warmly and long to see us, just as we long to see you.
verses.after: But Timothy has just now returned to us from you and brought us good news about your faith and love. He told us that you always remember us kindly and long to see us, just as we long to see you.
verses.tsw_comparator: But now that Timothy has come to us from you and has brought us good news of your faith and love and that you always remember us kindly, longing to see us just as we also long to see you,

verses.rationale: Keeps their faith as encouragement within real hardship.
verses.before: Therefore, brothers and sisters, in all our distress and affliction we were encouraged about you through your trust,
verses.after: Therefore, brothers and sisters, in all our distress and affliction we were encouraged about you through your faith.
verses.tsw_comparator: for this reason, brothers and sisters, in all our distress and affliction we have been comforted concerning you through your faith.

verses.rationale: Preserves the vivid life metaphor and condition.
verses.before: because now we truly live, if you stand firm in the Lord.
verses.after: For now we truly live, if you stand firm in the Lord.
verses.tsw_comparator: For now we live, if you are standing firm in the Lord.

verses.rationale: Keeps repayment language and overflowing joy before God.
verses.before: For what thanks can we return to God for you, for all the joy with which we rejoice before our God because of you?
verses.after: How can we repay God with enough thanks for you, for all the joy we feel because of you before our God?
verses.tsw_comparator: For what thanksgiving can we return to God for you, for all the joy that we feel for your sake before our God,

verses.rationale: Retains repeated time, personal presence and acknowledged lack.
verses.before: Night and day we pray very earnestly to see you face to face and complete what is lacking in your trust.
verses.after: Night and day we pray most earnestly that we may see you face to face and supply what is lacking in your faith.
verses.tsw_comparator: as we pray most earnestly night and day that we may see your face and supply what is lacking in your faith?

verses.rationale: Preserves the two named subjects with the singular-directed request.
verses.before: Now may our God and Father himself and our Lord Jesus direct our way to you.
verses.after: Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus, direct our way to you.
verses.tsw_comparator: Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus, direct our way to you,

verses.rationale: Keeps paired growth verbs and love's internal/external reach.
verses.before: And may the Lord make you increase and overflow in love for one another and for everyone, just as we do for you,
verses.after: And may the Lord make your love increase and overflow for one another and for everyone, just as ours does for you,
verses.tsw_comparator: and may the Lord make you increase and abound in love for one another and for all, just as we do for you,

verses.rationale: Preserves heart-strengthening, holiness and the future gathering.
verses.before: so that he may strengthen your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his holy ones. Amen.
verses.after: so that he may strengthen your hearts, blameless in holiness before our God and Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.
verses.tsw_comparator: so that he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his holy ones.

verses.rationale: Keeps acknowledged present obedience and the call to abound further.
verses.before: Finally then, brothers and sisters, we ask and urge you in the Lord Jesus that, just as you received from us how you ought to walk and please God—as you are in fact walking—you continue to do so even more.
verses.after: Finally then, brothers and sisters, we ask and urge you in the Lord Jesus: just as you received from us how you must walk and please God—as indeed you are walking—do so more and more.
verses.tsw_comparator: Finally then, brothers and sisters, we ask and urge you in the Lord Jesus that, just as you received from us how you ought to walk and to please God—just as you are doing—you should abound more and more.

verses.rationale: Retains their prior knowledge and the Lord's mediating authority.
verses.before: For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.
verses.after: For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.
verses.tsw_comparator: For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.

verses.rationale: Keeps holiness defined here by concrete sexual restraint.
verses.before: For this is God’s will: your holiness—that you stay away from sexual immorality,
verses.after: For this is God's will: your holiness—that you abstain from sexual immorality;
verses.tsw_comparator: For this is the will of God, your holiness: that you abstain from sexual immorality;

verses.rationale: Renders the ambiguous vessel as body while preserving personal mastery; the wife alternative belongs in a note.
verses.before: that each of you know how to control your own body in holiness and honor,
verses.after: that each of you know how to control your own body in holiness and honor,
verses.tsw_comparator: that each one of you know how to possess his own vessel in holiness and honor,

verses.rationale: Retains passion and the text's ethnic-religious comparison.
verses.before: not in passionate desire like the Gentiles who do not know God,
verses.after: not with lustful passion like the nations who do not know God;
verses.tsw_comparator: not in the passion of desire like the Gentiles who do not know God;

verses.rationale: Keeps sexual/economic wrongdoing language open and warns of divine redress.
verses.before: and that no one cross a boundary and exploit a brother or sister in this matter, because the Lord is an avenger in all these things, just as we told you before and solemnly warned you.
verses.after: that no one transgress and exploit a brother or sister in this matter, because the Lord is an avenger in all these things, as we told you before and solemnly warned you.
verses.tsw_comparator: that no one transgress and exploit his brother or sister in this matter, because the Lord is an avenger in all these things, just as we told you beforehand and solemnly warned you.

verses.rationale: Preserves calling and the strong moral contrast.
verses.before: For God did not call us to impurity but in holiness.
verses.after: For God did not call us to impurity but in holiness.
verses.tsw_comparator: For God did not call us for impurity, but in holiness.

verses.rationale: Keeps the rejected party, divine identity and present gift.
verses.before: Therefore the one who rejects this does not reject a human being but God, who also gives his Holy Spirit to you.
verses.after: Therefore, whoever rejects this does not reject a human being but God, who gives his Holy Spirit to you.
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore whoever rejects this rejects not a human being but God, who gives his Holy Spirit to you.

verses.rationale: Retains the sibling-love term and divine instruction.
verses.before: Now concerning love for brothers and sisters, you have no need for us to write to you, because you yourselves have been taught by God to love one another.
verses.after: Now concerning family love, you do not need us to write to you, for you yourselves are taught by God to love one another.
verses.tsw_comparator: Now concerning brotherly love, you have no need for anyone to write to you, for you yourselves have been taught by God to love one another,

verses.rationale: Keeps regional breadth, praise and continuing growth.
verses.before: Indeed, you are doing this toward all the brothers and sisters throughout Macedonia. But we urge you, brothers and sisters, to do so even more,
verses.after: And indeed you show this love to all the brothers and sisters throughout Macedonia. But we urge you to do so more and more,
verses.tsw_comparator: for indeed you are doing this toward all the brothers and sisters in all Macedonia. But we urge you, brothers and sisters, to abound more and more,

verses.rationale: Preserves the striking ambition for quietness and manual labor.
verses.before: and to make it your ambition to live quietly, mind your own affairs, and work with your hands, just as we instructed you,
verses.after: and to aspire to live quietly, attend to your own affairs and work with your own hands, just as we instructed you,
verses.tsw_comparator: and to aspire to live quietly, and to mind your own affairs, and to work with your hands, as we instructed you,

verses.rationale: Keeps public conduct and the ambiguous lack/dependence result.
verses.before: so that you may walk properly toward outsiders and have need of no one.
verses.after: so that you may walk honorably toward outsiders and depend on no one.
verses.tsw_comparator: so that you may walk properly before outsiders and be dependent on no one.

verses.rationale: Retains sleep metaphor, grief and the comparison without forbidding grief itself.
verses.before: We do not want you to be uninformed, brothers and sisters, about those who have fallen asleep, so that you do not grieve like the rest who have no hope.
verses.after: We do not want you to be uninformed, brothers and sisters, about those who are sleeping, so that you do not grieve like the rest, who have no hope.
verses.tsw_comparator: But we do not want you to be uninformed, brothers and sisters, about those who have fallen asleep, so that you may not grieve as others do who have no hope.

verses.rationale: Keeps death explicit for Jesus and sleep for the deceased.
verses.before: For if we trust that Jesus died and rose, in the same way God will bring with Jesus those who have fallen asleep through him.
verses.after: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose, in the same way God will bring with Jesus those who have fallen asleep through him.
verses.tsw_comparator: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, so also God will bring with him those who have fallen asleep through Jesus.

verses.rationale: Preserves first-person future perspective and the sequence.
verses.before: For this we tell you by the Lord’s word: we who are alive and remain until the Lord’s coming will certainly not precede those who have fallen asleep.
verses.after: For this we tell you by a word of the Lord: we who are alive and remain until the Lord's coming will certainly not precede those who have fallen asleep.
verses.tsw_comparator: For this we say to you by a word of the Lord, that we who are alive, who remain until the coming of the Lord, will certainly not precede those who have fallen asleep.

verses.rationale: Keeps all three sounds, descent and first resurrection.
verses.before: Because the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a commanding shout, with an archangel’s voice, and with God’s trumpet, and the dead in Christ will rise first.
verses.after: For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a commanding shout, with an archangel's voice and with God's trumpet, and the dead in Christ will rise first.
verses.tsw_comparator: For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a command, with the voice of an archangel, and with the trumpet of God, and the dead in Christ will rise first.

verses.rationale: Preserves sequence, communal catching up and meeting imagery.
verses.before: Then we who are alive and remain will be caught up together with them in clouds to meet the Lord in the air, and so we will always be with the Lord.
verses.after: Then we who are alive and remain will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air, and so we will always be with the Lord.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then we who are alive, who remain, will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air, and so we will always be with the Lord.

verses.rationale: Retains the stated pastoral purpose.
verses.before: Therefore encourage one another with these words.
verses.after: Therefore, encourage one another with these words.
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore encourage one another with these words.

verses.rationale: Keeps paired temporal terms and claimed prior knowledge.
verses.before: Now concerning the times and seasons, brothers and sisters, you have no need for anything to be written to you.
verses.after: Now concerning the times and seasons, brothers and sisters, you do not need anything written to you.
verses.tsw_comparator: Now concerning the times and the seasons, brothers and sisters, you have no need for anything to be written to you.

verses.rationale: Preserves day title and thief simile.
verses.before: For you yourselves know very well that the Lord’s day comes like a thief in the night.
verses.after: For you yourselves know very well that the day of the Lord comes like a thief in the night.
verses.tsw_comparator: For you yourselves know very well that the day of the Lord comes like a thief in the night.

verses.rationale: Keeps quoted confidence, birth-pain image and inescapability.
verses.before: When people are saying, “Peace and security,” then sudden destruction comes upon them like labor pains on a pregnant woman, and they will certainly not escape.
verses.after: When people say, “Peace and security,” sudden destruction will come on them like labor pains on a pregnant woman, and they will certainly not escape.
verses.tsw_comparator: When they are saying, “Peace and security,” then sudden destruction comes upon them, as labor pains upon a pregnant woman, and they will certainly not escape.

verses.rationale: Retains the contrast and surprise imagery.
verses.before: But you, brothers and sisters, are not in darkness so that the day should overtake you like a thief.
verses.after: But you, brothers and sisters, are not in darkness, so that the day should overtake you like a thief.
verses.tsw_comparator: But you are not in darkness, brothers and sisters, so that the day should overtake you like a thief;

verses.rationale: Preserves both kinship expressions and communal contrast.
verses.before: For you are all children of light and children of day. We do not belong to night or darkness.
verses.after: For you are all children of light and children of day. We do not belong to night or darkness.
verses.tsw_comparator: for you are all children of light and children of the day. We are not of the night or of darkness.

verses.rationale: Keeps paired alertness commands and sleep metaphor.
verses.before: Therefore let us not sleep like the rest, but let us stay awake and sober.
verses.after: So then, let us not sleep like the rest, but stay awake and sober.
verses.tsw_comparator: So then let us not sleep as the others do, but let us keep awake and be sober.

verses.rationale: Retains the two ordinary night activities supporting the metaphor.
verses.before: For those who sleep, sleep at night, and those who get drunk, get drunk at night.
verses.after: For those who sleep, sleep at night, and those who get drunk, get drunk at night.
verses.tsw_comparator: For those who sleep sleep at night, and those who get drunk are drunk at night;

verses.rationale: Keeps armor imagery and the faith-love-hope triad.
verses.before: But since we belong to the day, let us be sober, putting on the breastplate of trust and love and the helmet of the hope of salvation.
verses.after: But since we belong to day, let us be sober, putting on faith and love as a breastplate and the hope of salvation as a helmet.
verses.tsw_comparator: but since we belong to the day, let us be sober, having put on the breastplate of faith and love, and as a helmet the hope of salvation.

verses.rationale: Preserves opposed appointments and Christ's mediation.
verses.before: For God did not appoint us for wrath but for obtaining salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.after: For God did not appoint us to wrath but to obtain salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.tsw_comparator: For God has not appointed us for wrath, but for obtaining salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,

verses.rationale: Keeps death's purpose and the deliberately flexible awake/sleep pair.
verses.before: who died for us so that whether we are awake or asleep, we may live together with him.
verses.after: who died for us so that, whether we are awake or asleep, we may live together with him.
verses.tsw_comparator: who died for us, so that whether we are awake or asleep we may live together with him.

verses.rationale: Retains mutuality and acknowledges existing practice.
verses.before: Therefore encourage one another and build each other up, just as you are doing.
verses.after: Therefore, encourage one another and build each other up, just as you are doing.
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore encourage one another and build up one another, just as you are doing.

verses.rationale: Keeps three functions without importing later office titles.
verses.before: We ask you, brothers and sisters, to recognize those who labor among you, lead you in the Lord, and warn you,
verses.after: We ask you, brothers and sisters, to recognize those who labor among you, lead you in the Lord and warn you,
verses.tsw_comparator: Now we ask you, brothers and sisters, to respect those who labor among you and are over you in the Lord and admonish you,

verses.rationale: Preserves esteem's stated basis and communal peace command.
verses.before: and to regard them very highly in love because of their work. Be at peace among yourselves.
verses.after: and to regard them very highly in love because of their work. Live at peace among yourselves.
verses.tsw_comparator: and to esteem them very highly in love because of their work. Be at peace among yourselves.

verses.rationale: Retains four distinct responses to distinct conditions.
verses.before: We urge you, brothers and sisters: warn the disorderly, encourage the discouraged, support the weak, and be patient with everyone.
verses.after: We urge you, brothers and sisters: warn the disorderly, encourage the fainthearted, support the weak and be patient with everyone.
verses.tsw_comparator: And we urge you, brothers and sisters, admonish the idle, encourage the fainthearted, help the weak, be patient with all.

verses.rationale: Keeps universal nonretaliation and both circles of good.
verses.before: See that no one repays evil for evil to anyone, but always pursue what is good for one another and for everyone.
verses.after: See that no one repays anyone evil for evil, but always pursue what is good for one another and for everyone.
verses.tsw_comparator: See that no one repays evil for evil, but always pursue what is good for one another and for all.

verses.rationale: Preserves the terse absolute command.
verses.before: Rejoice always.
verses.after: Rejoice always.
verses.tsw_comparator: Rejoice always,

verses.rationale: Retains the terse persistence command.
verses.before: Pray without ceasing.
verses.after: Pray without ceasing.
verses.tsw_comparator: pray without ceasing,

verses.rationale: Distinguishes thanksgiving in circumstances from calling every circumstance good.
verses.before: Give thanks in everything, because this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.
verses.after: Give thanks in every circumstance, for this is God's will for you in Christ Jesus.
verses.tsw_comparator: give thanks in all circumstances; for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus for you.

verses.rationale: Keeps the fire metaphor and terse prohibition.
verses.before: Do not extinguish the Spirit.
verses.after: Do not extinguish the Spirit.
verses.tsw_comparator: Do not quench the Spirit,

verses.rationale: Preserves the plural utterances and prohibition.
verses.before: Do not despise prophecies,
verses.after: Do not despise prophecies,
verses.tsw_comparator: do not despise prophecies,

verses.rationale: Keeps discernment and retention as paired actions.
verses.before: but test everything; hold fast to what is good.
verses.after: but test everything; hold fast to what is good.
verses.tsw_comparator: but test everything; hold fast to what is good,

verses.rationale: Renders form/kind without reducing the command to mere appearances.
verses.before: Stay away from every form of evil.
verses.after: Keep away from every kind of evil.
verses.tsw_comparator: abstain from every form of evil.

verses.rationale: Preserves all three human terms, wholeness and future horizon.
verses.before: May the God of peace himself make you holy completely, and may your whole spirit, life, and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.after: Now may the God of peace himself make you holy through and through, and may your whole spirit, soul and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.tsw_comparator: Now may the God of peace himself sanctify you entirely, and may your whole spirit and soul and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.rationale: Keeps divine faithfulness as the ground of completion.
verses.before: The one who calls you is faithful; he will also do it.
verses.after: The one who calls you is faithful, and he will do it.
verses.tsw_comparator: The one who calls you is faithful, and he will do it.

verses.rationale: Retains the brief reciprocal request.
verses.before: Brothers and sisters, pray for us too.
verses.after: Brothers and sisters, pray for us.
verses.tsw_comparator: Brothers and sisters, pray for us.

verses.rationale: Preserves all recipients and embodied greeting.
verses.before: Greet all the brothers and sisters with a holy kiss.
verses.after: Greet all the brothers and sisters with a holy kiss.
verses.tsw_comparator: Greet all the brothers and sisters with a holy kiss.

verses.rationale: Keeps oath-like force and public reading requirement.
verses.before: I charge you by the Lord to have this letter read to all the brothers and sisters.
verses.after: I solemnly charge you by the Lord to have this letter read to all the brothers and sisters.
verses.tsw_comparator: I adjure you by the Lord that this letter be read to all the brothers and sisters.

verses.rationale: Retains the concise plural blessing.
verses.before: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
verses.after: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
verses.tsw_comparator: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
